name: Length of binary representation of n.
formula: a(0)=1, a(1)=1 and a(n) = 1+a(floor(n/2)). - _Benoit Cloitre_, Dec 02 2003

name: Tetrahedral (or triangular pyramidal) numbers: a(n) = C(n+2,3) = n*(n+1)*(n+2)/6.
formula: a(n) = -a(-4 - n) for all in Z.

name: Oblong (or promic, pronic, or heteromecic) numbers: a(n) = n*(n+1).
formula: Sum_{n >= 1} a(n) = n*(n+1)*(n+2)/3 (cf. A007290, partial sums).

name: The multiplicative partition function: number of ways of factoring n with all factors greater than 1 (a(1) = 1 by convention).
formula: The asymptotic behavior of this sequence was studied by Canfield, Erdős & Pomerance and Luca, Mukhopadhyay, & Srinivas. - _Jonathan Vos Post_, Jul 07 2008
If n = p^k for a prime p, a(n) = partitions(k) = A000041(k).

name: Pell numbers: a(0) = 0, a(1) = 1; for n > 1, a(n) = 2*a(n-1) + a(n-2).
formula: G.f.: x/(1 - 2*x - x^2). - _Simon Plouffe_ in his 1992 dissertation.

G.f.: Sum_{n >= 0} x^(n+1) *( Product_{k = 1..n} (2*k + x)/(1 + 2*k*x) ) = Sum_{n >= 0} x^(n+1) *( Product_{k = 1..n} (x + 1 + k)/(1 + k*x) ) = Sum_{n >= 0} x^(n+1) *( Product_{k = 1..n} (x + 3 - k)/(1 - k*x) ) may all be proved using telescoping series. - _Peter Bala_, Jan 04 2015

name: The nonnegative even numbers: a(n) = 2n.
formula: G.f. with interpolated zeros: 2x^2/((1-x)^2 * (1+x)^2); e.g.f. with interpolated zeros: x*sinh(x). - _Geoffrey Critzer_, Aug 25 2012

name: Decimal expansion of e.
formula: e is the unique positive root of the equation Integral_{u = 1..x} du/u = 1.

exp(1) = ((16/31)*(1 + Sum_{n>=1} ((1/2)^n*((1/2)*n^3 + (1/2)*n + 1)/n!)))^2. _Robert Israel_ confirmed that the above formula is correct, saying: "In fact, Sum_{n=0..oo} n^j*t^n/n! = P_j(t)*exp(t) where P_0(t) = 1 and for j >= 1, P_j(t) = t (P_(j-1)'(t) + P_(j-1)(t)). Your sum is 1/2*P_3(1/2) + 1/2*P_1(1/2) + P_0(1/2)." - _Alexander R. Povolotsky_, Jan 04 2009
